title: teller list serialises state ACTIVE; the stored m_tellers.state integer behind it is 300
_note: teller-status seam. request.teller_status.status_label ACTIVE is the status the teller list read-back serialised for both rows of tellers-list-raw.json (id 2 SEED-Teller-01 and id 1 SMOKE-Teller). expect.teller_status_stored 300 is the stored m_tellers.state integer Fineract's TellerStatus enum maps ACTIVE to (VERIFIED: TellerStatus.java). A wrong implementation that re-encodes the lifecycle state as a contiguous Go enum ordinal (branch-wrong-teller-status-ordinal returns 2) or bumps the stored value by one (branch-wrong-off-by-one returns 301) goes red; a label-only harness that never looked at the stored integer would not see either defect. Only the ACTIVE label appears in the branch captures: PENDING/INACTIVE/CLOSED were never serialised, so no other state may be pinned (oracle gap).

provenance.note: transcribed from .softhouse/capture/branch/out/tellers-list-raw.json (state label ACTIVE on tellers 2 and 1, stored m_tellers.state 300)
